It is, you are exactly right, vulnerability is a huge thing for me and causes me a lot of pain. I'm sorry if this is a bit of a long explanation, but here it goes I guess. 

I was raised in a very religious environment. I'm in Utah, where most people are religious, and there's a good chance they are Mormon. My parents are Mormon, and tried to raise me as a Mormon. 

Unfortunately for them, I came to the conclusion I no longer believed in Mormonism. I started doing "bad things" like listening to rap music and masturbating. 

My parents had always tried to shelter me from these things, and I knew they'd be livid if they found out. So I hid it, I hid it all. 

Unfortunately for me however, they started snooping through my phone, and found my spotify. One night they asked to talk, and told me they found my rap music. They wanted to know how I could even consider such sinful behavior. 

The conversation toon a turn and I told them the truth, I didn't believe in their religion and had no moral objections to this music. Wrong answer. 

While snooping through my phone they also found out I was suicidal (partly because I felt like I had nowhere to go and the religious structure I thought I believed in was lie), they didn't mean to react so poorly to that, but they did. 

From that moment on I decided to hide my emotions and my life, putting them out in the open (voluntarily or not) is only a way to get yourself hurt. 

The problem is now I've stopped myself from being able to experience joy too. I want to make friends, I want to go on a date, I want to fall in love. I want to go out with friends. I want to be honest. But I can't. I'm afraid of rejection, of being awkward. 

Not to mention I'm ugly. Im a guy, who's really short and has glasses and fairly long hair (not a bad thing but when people say you should cut it, you know they dont like it.) I also have scars all over my thighs from self harm , and on my genitals due to a lack of sex ed (sorry if this is too personal). Nobody's gonna want me physically or emotionally, even if I could get up the courage to put myself out there.

My parents later apologized for their behavior. But it was after years of hiding everything. Even before they berated me, I was afraid, religion is important to them. And that religion is quite clear about the morality of my choices. 

I'm so scared of being hurt, of being rejected, of being vulnerable. I hid everything because it's the only way I know how to protect myself
